meta.title: BusWatch: report and track bus incidents
meta.description: Report reckless driving, overcharging and other public transport incidents in Sri Lanka, then track what happens next.
meta.submitDescription: Report a bus incident with photos, video and a map pin. You get a receipt ID to track it.
meta.commendDescription: Tell us about a driver or crew who gave you a great ride. We pass your kind words on.
meta.trackDescription: Check the status of a BusWatch report with its receipt ID.
meta.aboutDescription: Why BusWatch exists and how passenger reports turn into better public transport.
meta.impactDescription: How many bus incidents passengers reported, how many were resolved, and what changed as a result.
meta.busDescription: Checked passenger reports and commendations for bus {bus}.
meta.routeDescription: Checked passenger reports and commendations for route {route}.
meta.myReportsDescription: See every report you sent with your email or mobile number. Sign in with a one-time code, no password.
meta.lostDescription: Tell us what you left on the bus. We pass it to the bus operator and let you know if it's found.
meta.fareDescription: Check the official bus fare between two stops, and report overcharging with proof.
meta.safetyDescription: A quick, quiet way to report harassment on a bus, emergency numbers, and live trip sharing with someone you trust.

footer.tagline: Your eye on public transport. Report incidents in minutes and follow every step until they are resolved.
footer.madeFor: Made for safer journeys in Sri Lanka.

home.subtitle: Reckless driving, overcharging, harassment? Report it in minutes with photos and a map pin, then track what happens next with your receipt ID.
home.heroAlt: Aerial view of buses and traffic at a busy city intersection
home.quickTrackText: Enter your receipt ID to see where it stands.
home.howTitle: From what you saw to what was done about it.
home.step1Text: Tell us the bus, the route and what happened. Add photos, video and a map pin if you have them.
home.step2Text: You receive a receipt ID straight away, plus a PDF copy by email if you leave your address.
home.step3Text: Our team reviews it, escalates it to the operator or authorities, and you see each update.
home.categoriesTitle: If it made your ride unsafe or unfair, it counts.
home.categoriesText: Every report is categorised and routed to the people who can act on it. Repeat offenders are flagged automatically.
home.commendTitle: Had a great ride? Say so.
home.commendText: A careful driver or a kind conductor deserves to hear it. Commend them in under a minute and we pass it on to the operator.
home.closingTitle: Your report is evidence. Let's make it count.
home.closingText: Patterns across reports show operators and authorities exactly where things go wrong.
home.safetyText: Report harassment quickly and quietly, call for help, or share your trip live with someone you trust.
home.lostText: Left a bag or phone on a bus? We pass it to the bus operator and tell you when it's found.
home.fareText: See the official fare between two stops. Overcharged? Report it with the proof attached.

about.title: Driving better commutes, together.
about.subtitle: We believe every voice matters in shaping a more efficient, safer and friendlier public transport system.
about.missionText: Our mission is to give daily commuters a simple tool to report, track and influence the quality of public bus services. By bridging the gap between passengers and transport authorities, we aim for a transparent, responsive network where feedback turns into real improvements.
about.visionText: We envision public transport that is consistently excellent, comfortable and reliable, with BusWatch as the leading platform for passenger advocacy and continuous improvement, driven by the insights of the community it serves.
about.safetyText: Helping identify and fix hazards before someone gets hurt.
about.punctualityText: Pinpointing skipped halts and missed schedules for more reliable service.
about.qualityText: Encouraging higher standards of vehicle maintenance and professionalism.
about.accessibilityText: Surfacing the challenges faced by passengers with disabilities.
about.communityText: Giving every commuter a voice that is recorded and followed up.
about.ctaText: Seen something on a bus? Your report is the first step.
about.contactText: We'd love to hear from you.

impact.title: Reporting works. Here's the proof.
impact.subtitle: Every number on this page comes from reports passengers sent and our team checked. Totals only: no names, no receipts, no exact times.
impact.categoriesSubtitle: Checked reports by kind of incident
impact.mapSubtitle: Each circle groups checked reports within about 5 km. Areas with fewer than {min} reports are not shown, so no single report can be located.
impact.mapEmpty: There are not enough checked reports with a map pin to show yet.
impact.routesSubtitle: Routes with at least {min} checked reports
impact.routesEmpty: No route has enough checked reports yet.
impact.storiesSubtitle: Cases our team followed up, written up without passenger details.
impact.storiesEmpty: Stories of resolved cases will appear here.
impact.lookupText: See checked reports and commendations for a bus. Scorecards appear once a bus has at least {min} checked reports.
impact.fairness1: Only reports our team has checked are counted. Unchecked and rejected reports never appear.
impact.fairness2: A bus or route gets a scorecard only after {min} checked reports, so one complaint can't define an operator.
impact.fairness3: Maps show areas, never individual reports, and no exact times.
impact.unavailable: The figures can't be loaded right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

whatsapp.followHint: Send STOP to BusWatch on WhatsApp at any time to stop.
whatsapp.chatText: Report a problem, praise a driver or track a report by chatting with BusWatch on WhatsApp. Type or send a voice note in Sinhala, Tamil or English, with photos.

fare.subtitle: Choose your route and stops to see the official fare. Paid more? Report it with the proof attached.
fare.howItWorks: Fares follow the NTC fare-stage list: the number of fare stages between your stops sets the fare.
